candidate_energy_source: minimum passing Pd2H8 endpoint from the registered five-volume structural gate

decision.between_0_and_0p15_eV_per_atom: continue with named metastability liability and compute fuller PdHx competing-phase hull
decision.less_than_or_equal_0_eV_per_atom: compute fuller PdHx competing-phase hull; elemental stability alone is not a hull pass

limitations: Electronic PBE energies without zero-point or finite-temperature corrections. A value near the threshold requires higher-level and vibrational uncertainty analysis; a value far above it is decisive for this campaign.
